A reviewer asks what the AIDX evaluation rubric is meant to measure. Which answer matches the document?
A) Whether AIDX safely reads one supplied plan, executes it sequentially, uses only named fallbacks, requires fresh proof, and stops on material risk
B) Whether AIDX can write a new plan from a free-form request and pick its own fallbacks

D) Whether AIDX asks the user many requirements questions before running anything

The rubric frontmatter sets minimumPassRate. What pass rate must the evaluated cases reach?
A) Half of the cases
B) 90 percent of the cases
C) Every case, a rate of 1
D) No minimum, the rate is only informational

A) public and private
B) hidden and shown
C) train and validation
D) candidate and challenge

Which verifier id does the rubric frontmatter list under verifierIds?
A) plan-validator
B) source-structure
C) final-gate
D) hidden-character
